_predicates: Rules are OR; event and payload fields are AND. Payload values use exact JSON equality, or one operator: gt (number), len_gt (list/string length), nonempty (true). Missing fields never match. eval_run:true requires a fetched run with at least one boolean acceptance_passed result; a queued run alone never matches. Evidence proves module execution, not correctness or full capability. No inferred UI visits. Planned modules have no rules.
